title: nephrodium filix-mas proles borreri
intro: Nephrodium filix-mas proles borreri, commonly known as Borrer's Lady Fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Borrer's Lady Fern include its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
